title: Ticket System Improvements
summary: The ticket experience has been made more reliable and easier for the team to manage.
added: Staff can use /tickets to add an existing channel to a ticket category or remove it later.
Staff can use /hr and /leadership to share the available position lists.
changed: Update announcements now describe what was added, changed, or removed instead of saying that the bot is running.
The ticket category menu resets after each choice, so it is ready to use again.
Ticket notifications no longer mention the same staff role twice.
Tickets now finish closing after a clear five-second countdown, and closure messages give members more helpful information.
Every bot update now notifies the Bot Updates role.
Ticket closure now uses one shorter direct-message embed, and its rating buttons remain available for 15 days.
removed: Tickets no longer stay open indefinitely while waiting for an optional rating.
